name: PTD-DBM
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: PTD-DBM is a structurally modified synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 1 pack size: 1 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Store the lyophilized powder at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is PTD-DBM tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Testing for PTD-DBM: HPLC purity against ≥99.0% (HPLC), MS confirmation of the intact mass, and a documented identity record (CAS 1609454-11-6, formula C124H225N61O28S2, 3082.6 Da). Results are reported per lot, not as a catalogue average.

faq.question: How should PTD-DBM be stored?
faq.answer: Hold the sealed 10-vial kit at −20 °C, away from light and humidity. Once reconstituted, aliquot and keep at 2–8 °C; this PTD preparation does not tolerate repeated freeze–thaw.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for PTD-DBM?
faq.answer: PTD-DBM is stocked in 1 pack size (1 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $57.32; 10–49 kits falls to $52.74 (−8%) and 50+ to $48.72 (−15%).

compliance: For Research, Laboratory, and Analytical Use Only. Not for Human or Veterinary Use.
